data_description.camera_entity: Camera entity to record. Its stream source is used unless a stream URL is set in the options.
data_description.folder: Folder inside a Home Assistant media folder. Day folders and the folder for protected events are created inside.
data_description.person_sensors: Highest priority for the file label.
data_description.pet_sensors: Second priority for the file label.

error.folder_not_in_media: The folder must be inside a Home Assistant media folder.

data_description.camera_entity: Camera entity to record. A new stream is started after saving.
data_description.folder: Folder inside a Home Assistant media folder. Existing recordings are not moved.
data_description.person_sensors: Highest priority for the file label.
data_description.pet_sensors: Second priority for the file label.
data_description.video_duration: The camera is locked for new events for this time. Videos are trimmed afterwards.
data_description.lookback: Seconds before the event. Keeps a stream running permanently. Starts at the previous keyframe. 0 = off.
data_description.post_motion: Video ends this long after the last sensor switched off. 0 = never trim.
data_description.snapshot_offset: Seconds after the event for the preview image.
data_description.retention_days: Older recordings are deleted daily at 03:30. Protected events are kept. 0 = keep forever.
data_description.rtsp_transport: Use tcp when the source is go2rtc.
data_description.use_wallclock_as_timestamps: Fixes corrupted recordings from cameras with broken timestamps.
data_description.stream_url: Overrides the camera's stream source, e.g. rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/garden_hd?video=all&audio=aac
data_description.favorites_folder: Sub folder for protected events, never deleted by the cleanup.

error.folder_not_in_media: The folder must be inside a Home Assistant media folder.
error.camera_in_use: This camera is already used by another entry.

not_a_recording.message: This file is not a recording of a configured camera.

toggle_favorite.name: Toggle protection
toggle_favorite.description: Moves a recording into the folder for protected events, or back into its day folder.

media_content_id.name: Media ID
media_content_id.description: Media source ID of the image or video.
